name: FinOps OpenRouter Live FOCUS & MongoDB Ingestion Pipeline

inputs.code:
// Node 4: FOCUS 1.0 & Exact AWS MongoDB 'finops_3' Schema
const input = $json;
if (!input.success) return input;

const { userId, connectionId, connectionName, productTag, environment, totalUsage, creditLimit, remainingBalance, cleanedKeys } = input;

// 1. Top Models by Real Spend
const topModelsBySpend = cleanedKeys
  .map(k => ({
    name: k.name,
    provider: 'OpenRouter',
    label: k.label,
    cost: k.usage,
    share: totalUsage > 0 ? Number(((k.usage / totalUsage) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 0,
    dailyCost: k.usageDaily,
    weeklyCost: k.usageWeekly,
    monthlyCost: k.usageMonthly,
    limit: k.limit,
    remaining: k.remaining,
    createdAt: k.createdAt
  }))
  .sort((a, b) => b.cost - a.cost);

// 2. Date-wise Telemetry Table
const dateWiseTelemetry = cleanedKeys.map(k => ({
  id: `telemetry_${k.keyId}`,
  date: k.createdAt.split('T')[0],
  keyName: k.name,
  keyLabel: k.label,
  keyCreatedAt: k.createdAt,
  app: productTag,
  model: k.name,
  cost: k.usage,
  dailyCost: k.usageDaily,
  weeklyCost: k.usageWeekly,
  monthlyCost: k.usageMonthly,
  environment: environment
}));

// 3. Exact MongoDB 'finops_3' Document Format (Matching AWS Schema)
const focusRecords = cleanedKeys.map(k => {
  const dateStr = k.createdAt.split('T')[0];
  const billingPeriod = dateStr.substring(0, 7);
  return {
    date: dateStr,
    service: `OpenRouter - ${k.name}`,
    userId: userId,
    connectionId: connectionId,
    operation: 'OpenRouterGatewaySync',
    accountId: k.workspaceId || 'openrouter-workspace',
    accountName: connectionName,
    amortizedCost: k.usage,
    billingPeriod: billingPeriod,
    blendedCost: k.usage,
    chargeDescription: `OpenRouter Key Inference - ${k.name}`,
    chargeType: 'Usage',
    netAmortizedCost: k.usage,
    netCost: k.usage,
    unblendedCost: k.usage,
    originalId: null,
    pricingCurrency: 'USD',
    pricingUnit: 'Tokens',
    region: 'global',
    resourceId: k.keyId,
    tags: {
      Project: productTag,
      Environment: environment,
      KeyLabel: k.label,
      Provider: 'OpenRouter'
    },
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    ChargePeriodStart: k.createdAt,
    ChargePeriodEnd: new Date().toISOString(),
    ProviderName: 'OpenRouter',
    ServiceName: 'OpenRouter AI Gateway',
    SubServiceName: k.name,
    BilledCost: k.usage,
    EffectiveCost: k.usage
  };
});

return {
  success: true,
  userId,
  connectionId,
  connectionName,
  productTag,
  environment,
  totalUsage,
  creditLimit,
  remainingBalance,
  recordsIngested: cleanedKeys.length,
  keysList: cleanedKeys,
  topModelsBySpend,
  dateWiseTelemetry,
  focusRecords
};
